sentences.text: It is the case of the prosecution which is an offshoot of a complaint case that on the promise of providing pathway to a landlocked plot, the accused persons have defalcated a sum of Rs.24,72,000/-(Rupees twenty four lakh seven two thousand).

6. It is alleged that the petitioner (Lokanath Barik @ Muna) in BLAPL No.10999 of 2022 is stated to have taken a sum of Rs.6,00,000/-(Rupees six lakhs) and the balance by the petitioner (Raka @
Rakesh @ Nursingha Charan Jena) in BLAPL No.113 of 2023.
7.

It is stated that the petitioner (Lokanath Barik @ Muna) in BLAPL No.10999 of 2022 is in custody from 12.10.2022 and the petitioner (Raka @ Rakesh @ Nursingha Charan Jena) in BLAPL No.113 of 2023 is in custody since 04.12.2022 and it is further submitted that as charge sheet has filed in the meanwhile on 10.12.2022, their further continuance in custody is unwarranted.
8.
Learned counsel for the State as well as informant oppose the prayer for bail inter alia on the ground that both the petitioners have criminal antecedents of similar nature.

And, it is further submitted by the learned counsel for the informant that since it is an economic offence, it has to be dealt with sternly and merely because final form has been submitted, no leniency ought to be shown.

9. The petitioner (Lokanath Barik @ Muna) in BLAPL No.10999 of 2022 as well as the petitioner (Raka @ Rakesh @ Nursingha Charan Jena) in BLAPL No.113 of 2023 have filed undertakings and affidavit respectively.

10. It is inter alia stated during that without prejudice to their rights, to prove their bonefides, they are ready to deposit a portion of the amount which is the subject matter of dispute and modality thereof has been indicated in the said undertaking and the affidavit.

11. In terms of the comprehensive undertaking given in BLAPL No.10599 of 2022, the said petitioner shall prepare a demand draft of Rs.30,000/-(Rupees thirty thousand) in favour of Ashisa Kumar Swain-complainant No.8.

Payment of the same to said Ashisa Kumar Swain shall be in his representative capacity and shall be the condition precedent for releasing the petitioners on bail and the further amount of Rs.5,70,000/-(Rupees five lakh seventy thousand) in ten equal installments first of which to commence from 01.06.2023 shall also be paid to the said Ashisa Kumar Swain, who shall execute indemnity bonds for each drafts received by him.
12.

And, it is needless to state that the payment made by the petitioner does not in any way fortify the stand of the prosecution regarding the complicity of the petitioner which, has to be adjudged on the basis of materials on record independently.

sentences.text:
In BLAPL No.113 of 2023 by way of affidavit, it has been indicated that the petitioner (Raka @
Rakesh @ Nursingha Charan Jena) without prejudice to his rights shall upfront pay a sum of Rs.50,000/-(Rupees fifty thousand) and a further sum of Rs.15,87,000/-(Rupees fifteen lakh eighty seven thousand) in fifteen equal installments of each, the dates of such equal installments shall be same as above.

The payment of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees fifty thousand) by way of demand draft in favour of Ashisa Kumar Swain-complainant No.8, in his representative capacity shall be the condition precedent for releasing him on bail.

The rest of the amount of Rs.15,87,000/-(Rupees fifteen lakh eighty seven thousand) in fifteen equal installments on the date fixed shall also be paid by way of demand draft to the said complainant No.8 who shall execute an indemnity bond in respect of each of the drafts received by him.

14. Considering the nature of allegations, taking into account the undertakings as noted above and keeping in view the the guidelines, as fixed by the Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil vrs. Central Bureau of Investigation & Another, reported in 2022 (10) SCC 51, this Court directs the petitioners to be released on bail on further terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin which shall ensure that the installments as undertaken are paid on the date it becomes due and any failure shall entail cancellation in accordance with law.
